thesis: Round 40 cell on the taxable trading book. The base entry 'close crosses_above bb_mid(20, 2)' and the exit 'close crosses_below bb_mid(20, 2)' are held IDENTICAL across every cell in this round; the only thing that varies within a slot cap is the confirmation conjunct added to the entry. This is the CONTROL: the bare base entry, no confirmation term. Every other arm is reported as arm-minus-this-control on median exposure-adjusted excess, never against SPY. Slot cap 3 (position size chosen so gross commitment is ~0.75 either way, so the cap varies breadth of book, not exposure). The hypothesis under test is the influencer persona creator-e's claim that a signal is only valid with a confirmation term; that persona's corpus is partly Korean-language and machine-summarised, so this is a fair test of the claim, not an endorsement. Pre-registered 2026-09-09 before any measurement. Not investment advice. See strategy-program/ROUND-40-PLAN.md.
falsification: Baseline against which every treatment is measured. Honest prior: the null (rounds 17/18/34 put form, exit and rotation all inside the 21.2pp floor). Pre-registered predictions with named failure regimes: (1) No treatment arm beats the control by more than 21.2pp on median adjusted excess AND survives BH q<0.10 with the denominator = every cell run; if one does, a confirmation conjunct pays for itself. (2) The divergence-proxy negative control is INDISTINGUISHABLE from the 'none' control (|arm-control| < 21.2pp), because it retains ~93% of the base's firings. If it separates, the metric or the store moved. (3) Both treatments take materially fewer trades and lower exposure than the control (they retain ~11-14% of firings); if a treatment's trade count is NOT below the control's, the conjunct did not bind. (4) Sign flips by regime: in a strong trend (recent, bull-2024) the confirmation delays entry and gives back early upside, while in chop it avoids false starts -- so any single-window arm-minus-control read is unsafe and only the median across the eight main windows is interpreted. (5) Degenerate-outcome guard: a heavily filtered treatment at slot cap 6 may take so few trades that it fails the 5-of-8 regime gate in some windows and is UNRANKED -- that is 'switched off', NOT 'the conjunct did not help', and the two must not be conflated.
